entries.name: bash_set_e_error_propagation
entries.guard: set -e has context-dependent exceptions for conditionals, lists, pipelines, subshells, and command substitutions; it is a shell policy, not a complete transactional or deterministic-state guarantee
entries.required_evidence: fixed shell version, explicit pipeline/ERR-trap contract, side-effect rollback or cleanup contract, fail-closed corpus, stdout, SHA-256 chain

entries.name: typescript_as_const_literal_readonly
entries.guard: as const is a compile-time assertion that narrows literal expressions and applies readonly typing; it does not provide universal runtime immutability, and referenced external objects remain outside the guarantee
entries.required_evidence: pinned TypeScript compiler, exact literal-expression rules, runtime boundary contract, mutation and alias corpus, emitted-code reproducibility evidence

entries.name: rust_repr_align
entries.guard: repr(align(N)) specifies a minimum type alignment but does not make an address, target ABI, allocator, or absolute layout universally deterministic; the proposed raw-pointer address test conflicts with the UORI raw_pointers DENY rule
entries.required_evidence: pinned target triple and compiler, size/alignment/layout manifest, allocator boundary, FFI contract, no-raw-pointer MAL representation, cross-target evidence

entries.name: c_restrict_aliasing_contract
entries.guard: restrict is a programmer aliasing promise whose violation can produce undefined behavior; it does not itself provide safe enforcement or a deterministic fallback, and its pointer-based model conflicts with the UORI raw_pointers DENY rule
entries.required_evidence: MAL handle/ownership translation, alias checker, defined violation result, compiler/optimization contract, negative corpus, no undefined behavior path

entries.name: sql_unique_constraint
entries.guard: UNIQUE can enforce a key invariant at a specified database boundary, but NULL semantics, collation, transaction isolation, conflict behavior, and query ordering must be fixed; it does not prove deterministic storage or result ordering
entries.required_evidence: pinned SQL engine/version, schema and collation contract, NULL and conflict semantics, isolation model, canonical query ordering, migration and replay corpus
